text:
maria: morning async check-in — quick rundown. What I did: landed kernel change that moves the per-batch lock to the microqueue level instead of global queue. Local perf harness shows ~6% p50 and ~9% p99 improvement on short sequences. Also added a small backoff to avoid hot-shard contention.

maria: blocker: observed a rare ordering hum when a prefetch and an eviction race on the same shard — reproducer lives at `infra/tests/replica_shard_race.cc` but it's flaky in CI. Need eyes from @alex or @chet on the eviction ordering patch.

alex: nice! I'll pull the branch and run the reproducer, can you ping me the PR number? curious if the lock relocation could affect KV cache invariants.

maria: PR #4621 — note the critical change is in `kernel/batcher.cc` around `enqueue_locked()`; I added a fast path that skips global lock for single-shard microqueues.

chet: reading it now. my quick thought: if prefetch increments `pending_count` before we hand off to microqueue, an eviction that checks `pending_count==0` could slip through. adding an extra atomic fence may help. I'll sketch a patch.

taylor: small FYI — perf-bot ran the nightly microbench with your branch and posted results:
```
perf-bot: nightly-microbench (branch: maria/lock-microqueue)
- 50th: -6.3%
- 95th: -7.8%
- 99th: -9.1%
- throughput: +2.4%
```

taylor: looks solid. can we dogfood on dedicated staging for a few hours after the extra fence? want to watch reclaim/evict rates under mixed traffic.

maria: yes planning a short canary on staging around 13:30 PT. ops-bot, can you schedule the canary window and bump the staging route to the branch?

ops-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-03-17T13:30:00-07:00 -> 2026-03-17T14:00:00-07:00. Route `staging/eng-runtime` -> `branch/maria/lock-microqueue` for 30m. Will post metrics link when active. :robot_face:

chet: posted a draft fix to PR that adds `atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_seq_cst)` around the pending_count update and a unit test that forces eviction ordering. still running.

alex: will run the flaky reproducer against your branch after chet's unit test lands. if it passes, i'll approve and we can promote to staging.

maria: thanks all — today plan: iterate on race fix, run a 5k-req microbench with mixed seq lengths, and watch staging canary. If anyone sees regressions in tracing (esp. queue time spikes), call me or drop an @maria.

perf-bot: quick note: added a new metric to the bench dashboard: `microqueue_contention_ratio` (tagged by shard_id) — use `?panel=microqueue_contention_ratio` on the nightly dashboard.

alex: acked. I'll also check the batching heuristics for very short sequences — might tweak the aggregation window if contention persists.

maria: cool — thanks, closing the loop for now. :thumbsup:
